wire_type_mapping.wire_reachability_note: Stock Renewal rows establish source-data reachability for wire type 18; DelayConsume rows emit as 2, pet eggs as 4, and shadowgear as 4 or 5. Other enum IDs pass through itemtype() unchanged. This does not establish any individual row is in a player inventory or on a deployed server.
wire_type_mapping.counting_method: Exact case-sensitive Type scalars at four-space item-row indentation; usable data contains 740 DelayConsume and two Delayconsume spellings. Their combined count is 742, but exact source spellings are retained here.
